title: Phoenix XDNA1 NPU 20-Core Silicon Execution, Batched xrt::runlist, Configured Context (16K-262K), and NVMe Direct I/O Co-Optimization

hardware.npu: AMD Phoenix XDNA1 (AIE2) 5 columns x 4 rows = 20 compute tiles + 5 MemTiles
hardware.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX Laptop GPU (8 GiB GDDR6, 128-bit bus)

gemm_throughput_comparison.comparison_scope: The retained legacy 16-tile field corresponds to 1.9246 TFLOPS derived from an N=1024 median NPU-only interval of 2.7895 ms. The 20-tile result uses N=1280 and host start/wait timing. This is not a matched shape or timing-boundary comparison.
gemm_throughput_comparison.architectural_finding: The timings do not establish a DMA-stall percentage or the reason for the compiler's four-column constraint. The retained builder maps B/C streams for compute columns 0 and 1 to shim column 1, and compute columns 2, 3 and 4 to their corresponding shim columns. The earlier column-3-sharing and 25% stall explanation was unsupported and is withdrawn. These runs do not establish the cause of historical driver timeouts or general device stability.

gufo_npu4_confirmation.residual_scope: Legacy non_xrt_cpu field names describe worker elapsed time minus XRT elapsed time, not CPU busy time. Median residuals were 3185.108 and 598.528 ms across 644 jobs, or 0.9294 ms/job after the change. The 0.64 ms/job value is from the separate same-binary screen.

phase3_long_context_and_nvme_coopt.context_scope: Configured capacities reach 262144 tokens. Document workloads were labeled 2048, 4096 and 8192 tokens, plus 16384 at the largest configured capacity. This does not qualify a 262144-token input request or quality at that length.

nvme_direct_io.host_page_cache_thrashing: Not measured. Read rows/s is a startup component probe, not request-averaged SSD throughput.

coopt_262k_benchmarks.configuration_scope: Completed profile used k8v4, 586 expert-cache slots, 720 MiB reserve and requested 1024-token prefill. Startup reported automatic own-buffer allocation. Separate explicit no-prefill-borrow/auto-cache/300-MiB-reserve profiles at this capacity failed startup. Document labels exclude 24 additional processed prompt tokens.

nvme_tiered_experts_28gib_ram_cap.io_counter_scope: The legacy per_query values above belong to the first short-chat request (34 processed prompt tokens, 128 generated tokens), not the 8K document. The 8K document processed 8216 prompt tokens and reported 225 file blobs / 480.8 MiB. Resident budget refers to engine expert storage, not total system RAM. Memory faults were not measured.
